I grepped every direct_midi_probe.jsonl under .planning/ (and every unique_cc list in *.json*) — NONE contains a CC34 frame; the sampled probes show frames:0. items.title: 4446f674 binding DOES touch the speech path (recent_moves) — no grounding-review attached
items.detail: The profile change (pioneer_ddj_flx4.json: new `jog_move_b_alt` = {channel:1, cc:34, axis:relative, deck:B, field:jog}) is purely additive — the existing jog_move_b (CC33) and every other binding are byte-for-byte unchanged (confirmed via git show; the only +line is the one binding). BUT a relative jog CC routes through ControllerState at state.py:348-350, which calls _record_move('B_jog nudge forward/back') into the recent-moves ring — and recent_moves IS citable coach evidence. So this commit changes what controller evidence can reach a reaction: a real B-jog on CC34 that was previously invisible now surfaces as a citable move. This is HONEST/grounded behavior (it fires only on an actual CC34 tick, never invents a move — consistent with Invariant #3), so it is not slop, but it crosses the 'what feeds the speech surface' line and the task contract puts such changes on HOLD pending vibemix-grounding-review + proof. The proof half is the HIGH item above (CC34 artifact missing). The change is functionally correct and tests pass (test_flx4_decode_live_discovered_b_jog_cc34_variant + _cc_lookup count 15->16, all 40 touched MIDI tests pass); recommend a grounding-review sign-off given the recent_moves coupling, and resolve the missing-proof item, before landing toward release.

# Verdict

All landed speech-surface commits are anti-slop tightening, and the two stale MEDIUM findings are now resolved at HEAD. **CRITICAL: `tests/repo` is RED on this branch** — the Phase-99 `stop_reason` confinement gate fails on a *committed* regression (b3828752 + 4027dc18). This is a checker regression that blocks a clean landing until the whitelist is expanded with justification. Three of four repo guards are GREEN; the dirty-package plan stays covered.

| SHA | Subject | Speech/timing? | Verification | Disposition |

Strips citation atoms first so a Turkish track name in an English sentence passes. Tests green.
- **54ec38be (citation atoms out of TTS) — CONFIRMED FIXED.** Real impl `src/vibemix/agent/tts_sanitizer.py` (`model_text_for_tts` → `strip_emote_tags` + `strip_citations_for_tts`), wired at `dj_cohost.py:67`/`:2638`. **Non-speech (4 verified + 2 benign):** c1b85304 / 1b51ef89 / 4bc30e66 are CLEAN (LAND), tests pass (25 + 42 + 9). de520ed9 keeps muted-MOSS quiet without cloud fallback (MOSS-only HOLD respected). **4446f674 is the only non-speech commit on HOLD** (see below).

The DROP-call live-speech **activation** (`runtime/coach.py:696-718` say-block via `mastered_speak(reaction_line(drop_cue))` + `continue`) and its arming gate (`event_detector._drop_call_enabled`) are **dirty-only** — `git show HEAD:src/vibemix/runtime/coach.py` has no DROP block; HEAD `event_detector.py` emits no DROP at all.
